description: This file defines functions and constants related to configuring and creating Slack WebClient instances, including default retry options and helper functions for option resolution.

methods.name: export function resolveSlackWebClientOptions(options: WebClientOptions = {}): WebClientOptions { resolveSlackWebClientOptions
methods.description: Resolves and combines user-supplied options with default retry configuration for Slack web clients.

methods.name: export function resolveSlackWriteClientOptions(options: WebClientOptions = {}): WebClientOptions/ resolveSlackWriteClientOptions
methods.description: Resolves and combines user-supplied options with write-specific retry configuration for Slack.

methods.name: export function createSlackWebClient(token: string, options: WebClientOptions = {}) { createSlackWebClient
methods.description: Creates a new Slack WebClient instance with specified token and options.

methods.name: export function createSlackWriteClient(token: string, options: WebClientOptions = {}) { createSlackWriteClient
methods.description: Creates a new Slack WebClient instance optimized for write operations with specified token and options.
